title: Microsoft Viva: Interactive insights in Agent 365 Business Analytics
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, preview behaviour and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should distinguish unpublished feature-specific licensing from published app prerequisites, complete the two policy-wizard paths and keep the general availability date conditional.
